_about: Top 50 most common pet aquarium fish. Searched instantly by name, alias and scientific name before any online lookup. Care values are typical hobby ranges. Fill photos with: node scripts/fill-catalogue-images.js (from the backend folder)

fish.name: Betta
fish.diet: Carnivore: betta pellets, bloodworms, brine shrimp
fish.description: Colourful labyrinth fish that breathes air at the surface. Keep one male per tank and avoid fin-nippers.

fish.name: Guppy
fish.description: Hardy, colourful livebearer that breeds easily. Great for beginners.

fish.name: Neon tetra
fish.diet: Omnivore: micro pellets, flakes, frozen foods
fish.description: Tiny schooling fish with a glowing blue and red stripe. Needs a stable, cycled tank.

fish.name: Cardinal tetra
fish.origin: Rio Negro and Orinoco, South America
fish.description: Like a neon tetra but with red along the whole belly. Prefers soft, slightly acidic water.

fish.name: Goldfish
fish.diet: Omnivore: sinking goldfish pellets, vegetables, gel food
fish.description: Cool-water fish that grows big and makes a lot of waste. Needs a large tank and strong filter.

fish.name: Molly
fish.description: Hardy livebearer that likes harder water and grazes on algae.

fish.name: Platy
fish.description: Cheerful, easy livebearer in many colours. Good community fish.

fish.name: Swordtail
fish.description: Active livebearer; males grow a long sword-shaped tail fin.

fish.name: Zebra danio
fish.description: Fast, hardy striped fish that loves open swimming space.

fish.name: Angelfish
fish.description: Tall, elegant cichlid. May eat very small fish like neons once fully grown.

fish.name: Bronze corydoras
fish.description: Friendly bottom-dwelling catfish that sifts sand for food. Keep in groups on soft sand.

fish.name: Panda corydoras
fish.description: Small cory with panda-like black patches. Prefers cooler, clean water.

fish.name: Harlequin rasbora
fish.diet: Omnivore: flakes, micro pellets, frozen foods
fish.description: Peaceful schooling fish with a black triangle patch. Great in planted tanks.

fish.name: Cherry barb
fish.description: Calm barb; males turn bright cherry red. Not a fin-nipper.

fish.name: Tiger barb
fish.description: Bold, active striped barb. Keep in a big group or it nips long fins.

fish.name: Dwarf gourami
fish.description: Bright labyrinth fish. Keep one male; buy from a good source as they can carry disease.

fish.name: Pearl gourami
fish.description: Peaceful gourami covered in pearly spots. Likes plants and calm water.

fish.name: Honey gourami
fish.description: Small, shy golden gourami. Good choice for small community tanks.

fish.name: Bristlenose pleco
fish.description: The best pleco for home tanks: stays small and eats algae. Needs driftwood to graze.

fish.name: Common pleco
fish.description: Often sold small but grows very large. Only for very big tanks.

fish.name: Otocinclus
fish.diet: Herbivore: algae, algae wafers, blanched zucchini
fish.description: Tiny algae eater for planted tanks. Add only to a mature tank with algae.

fish.name: Kuhli loach
fish.description: Eel-like loach that hides in sand. More active in groups and dim light.

fish.name: Clown loach
fish.description: Playful striped loach that eats snails. Grows big and needs a group.

fish.name: White cloud minnow
fish.description: Hardy cool-water fish. Great for unheated tanks.

fish.name: Black skirt tetra
fish.description: Hardy tetra with a dark flowing skirt. May nip long fins.

fish.name: Serpae tetra
fish.description: Bright red tetra. Known for nipping fins if kept in small groups.

fish.name: Ember tetra
fish.description: Tiny orange tetra that glows in planted tanks. Perfect for nano tanks.

fish.name: Rummy-nose tetra
fish.diet: Omnivore: micro pellets, flakes, frozen foods
fish.description: Tight-schooling tetra with a red nose. Its colour fades when water quality drops.

fish.name: Glowlight tetra
fish.description: Peaceful tetra with a glowing orange line. Very good community fish.

fish.name: Lemon tetra
fish.description: Pale yellow tetra with yellow and black fins. Hardy and calm.

fish.name: Congo tetra
fish.description: Large, shimmering African tetra with flowing fins. Needs swimming room.

fish.name: Discus
fish.diet: Carnivore: discus pellets, bloodworms, beef heart mix
fish.description: The king of the aquarium. Needs very warm, soft, very clean water and frequent water changes.

fish.name: Oscar
fish.description: Big, smart cichlid with lots of personality. Eats small fish and needs a huge tank.

fish.name: German blue ram
fish.diet: Omnivore: small pellets, bloodworms, brine shrimp
fish.description: Beautiful dwarf cichlid that needs warm, soft, very stable water.

fish.name: Bolivian ram
fish.description: Hardier cousin of the blue ram. Peaceful cichlid for community tanks.

fish.name: Kribensis
fish.diet: Omnivore: sinking pellets, flakes, frozen foods
fish.description: Colourful West African dwarf cichlid. Pairs guard their fry and get territorial.

fish.name: Convict cichlid
fish.description: Tough striped cichlid that breeds readily and defends its area hard.

fish.name: Electric yellow cichlid
fish.description: Bright yellow Malawi cichlid. One of the calmer mbuna for African tanks.

fish.name: Cockatoo dwarf cichlid
fish.diet: Carnivore: small pellets, bloodworms, brine shrimp
fish.description: Small cichlid with a spiky fin crest. Likes caves and leaf litter.

fish.name: Endler's livebearer
fish.description: Tiny, very bright relative of the guppy. Perfect for small tanks.

fish.name: Celestial pearl danio
fish.diet: Omnivore: micro pellets, daphnia, brine shrimp
fish.description: Tiny spotted fish for planted nano tanks. Shy at first.

fish.name: Chili rasbora
fish.diet: Omnivore: micro foods, crushed flakes, baby brine shrimp
fish.description: One of the smallest aquarium fish. Bright red in a dark, planted tank.

fish.name: Rosy barb
fish.description: Hardy, active barb that does well in cooler water.

fish.name: Siamese algae eater
fish.description: Top algae eater, even for black beard algae. Needs room as it grows.

fish.name: Rainbow shark
fish.description: Dark body with red fins. Territorial: keep only one.

fish.name: Red-tailed black shark
fish.description: Velvet black fish with a bright red tail. Chases fish that look like it.

fish.name: Boesemani rainbowfish
fish.description: Half blue, half orange rainbowfish. Active schooler that needs a long tank.

fish.name: Paradise fish
fish.description: Hardy labyrinth fish that copes with cool water. Males fight each other.

fish.name: Marbled hatchetfish
fish.diet: Carnivore: small insects, flakes, fruit flies
fish.description: Surface fish shaped like a hatchet. Jumps well: keep the lid on.

fish.name: Pea puffer
fish.description: Tiny, curious freshwater puffer. Eats snails and nips fins; best kept alone.
